extraction.Name: Rose Cordier (Setter)
extraction.Recorded patent: The instrument was recorded Sept. 30, 1920 by Rose Cordier Wolf Setter
extraction.Buyer: Rose Cordier Wolf Setter, formerly Rose Cordier, and Frank O. Setter conveyed the land to Sol L. Degen for $4400.00, but Degen and his wife gave Rose Cordier Wolf Setter a mortgage on the land for $2800.00, due in five yearly installments
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 732782 issued; northwest quarter of section 10, township 99, range 76; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; conveyance dated April 16, 1928; also known as Rose Cordier Wolf Setter and formerly Rose Cordier
